fields.description:
AL-1: Link Core Fields

Give the Link object its own record page with the core fields already scoped at summary level in the Deal doc.

FIELDS

Link ID (auto-numbered, read-only)

Deal (lookup)

Link Code

Active (toggle/checkbox) — controls CMS-dropdown availability

Tracking URL (long text)

Assignment Cap

~~Active Assignments (rollup, read-only) — count of reps currently on this link~~

* Ignore Active Assignment rollups for now until we have more info on wether CMS will send Link Assignments during DRA Sync. 

‌

IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

Same fields as the Deal doc's Link object (DL-5) — see [BUILD-216 — Deal: Link Object + Assignment Fields (toggle)](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693812480978/f/) for the underlying field definitions.

Whether Active can render as an interactive slider/toggle inside a screen flow (AL-4), or falls back to a static checkbox, is unresolved. If the screen flow cannot support an interactive toggle, fall back to a static checkbox display.

The underlying object is still called "Links," not "Affiliate Link." A rename is being considered but is not decided — build against "Links" for now; naming can be updated after build if the rename is confirmed.

NOTES

Provenance: AL-1 (Affiliate Link Record User Stories doc).

Mirrors DL-5 (BUILD-216) — same underlying Link object; this ticket is that object's dedicated record-page build.

SOURCE

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsJXwt3oY-DyQuAdMzNYlyPenKUQl7g8mHzMmeRaVHs/edit?tab=t.nyoinaymgezg](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsJXwt3oY-DyQuAdMzNYlyPenKUQl7g8mHzMmeRaVHs/edit?tab=t.nyoinaymgezg)

Aug 19, 2026 Kobi/Taryn Daily Sync — not confirmed via Fathom; no recording of this meeting was found in the connected account. Sourced from Taryn's own documentation of that conversation, not from an independently checked transcript.

Dependencies: [BUILD-216 — Deal: Link Object + Assignment Fields (toggle)](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693812480978/f/) (same object, DL-5)

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Created 2026-08-20 from Affiliate Link record documentation review.

comments.body:
For more context:

Kobi Kunasekaran, on the Active toggle: "I don't know if we're going to be able to do it in the screen flow... either this or a checkbox should be possible... I don't know if it'll be interactive... it might just show the checkbox." Kobi was checking with Marc "Jester" Cabantog. This supersedes the similar open question raised in the Deal doc (DL-7 / BUILD-218).

Kobi Kunasekaran, on the object rename: "I think we'll have to rename this... let me check with Chester and confirm if there's going to be any issues."

Update: The Link tab is now live in the org.

Steps done:

* Added a Tab for the Link object in Setup.

* Confirmed the Page Layout Assignment. All profiles use the Link Layout.

* Picked a tab style for the new tab.

* Added the tab to the Wagertech Console app.

Result: Users can now open Link records from the tab in the org.
Outstanding: Active Assignments (rollup, read-only) — count of reps currently on this link

Completed foundation is being closed as Done. Do not reopen this reviewed ticket for the later CMS design changes. New Link identity is tracked in WAGR-490; generic CMS exclusion/deactivate-before-delete safety is WAGR-491; outbound payload behavior is WAGR-456. Confluence remains the current requirements source: https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/269090817/03+User+Stories+Jira+Disposition
